lines.text: Cain farms and Abel keeps sheep, and the LORD favors Abel's offering of the best portions of his flock but not Cain's.
The LORD warns Cain that sin is crouching at his door, and Cain kills his brother Abel in the field.
Asked where Abel is, Cain says he does not know, and the LORD says the ground will no longer yield to him and he will be a servant to his father.
The LORD puts a mark on Cain, who settles in the land of Goshen, east of Eden, and builds a city named for his son Enoch.
Lamech boasts that he will be avenged seventy-sevenfold, and Eve names her son Seth in place of Abel, and Seth's son is Enosh.
